items.title: Last chance to submit Adult Intestinal Failure Registry Q2 2026 data
items.summary: The reporting period for collection of Adult Intestinal Failure Registry data for Q2 2026, covering 1st July to 30th September 2026, will close at midnight on Friday 16th October 2026.

items.title: BAPEN Position Statement on The Role Nutritional Support in the Management of Disease-Related malnutrition
items.summary: This position statement explores the role of nutritional support in the management of disease-related malnutrition, highlighting the importance of early identification and appropriate, evidence-based intervention.

items.title: Become a Mentor
items.summary: BAPEN runs a mentoring programme which is free for its members. You can either join as a mentor to help someone or as a mentee to get support and guidance in your career journey. Mentoring is an excellent opportunity to develop leadership, communication skills and build a professional network.

items.title: BACME ME/CFS Tube Feeding Survey Report
items.summary: The British Association of Clinicians in ME/CFS (BACME) Tube Feeding Survey Report has now been published on the BACME website.

items.title: BAPEN Medical are looking to broaden their membership
items.summary: Are you a doctor or surgeon and a BAPEN member? If so you are also a member of BAPEN Medical? BAPEN Medical are a core group of BAPEN which is primarily aimed at doctors with an interest in clinical nutrition.
